response.overview: Bara (Jordan Omar) is the spoiled son of a super-protective mother (Agla Artalidia), while his father (Ramon Y Tungka) is an adventurous motorcycle mechanic. One day, without his mother’s knowledge, Bara’s father signs him up for a camping trip in the forest. While camping, Bara wanders off from the group and meets a new friend. Bara and his friends’ adventure turns into a tense situation when they face a series of unexpected events that test their courage and teamwork.
response.title: Bara & Hutan Rahasia
